production.direction_en: Sable and Rikka slip into a signal tower while the party draws guards away from the bell rope.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (stealth, pizzicato) | post: bgm_revelation on 'This order names Fadyme.'

commands.speaker: rikka_ember
commands.text: I can break the door. I can also break the whole wall. Which one do you want?

commands.speaker: sable_wren
commands.text: The door. We are rescuing prisoners, not improving the view.

commands.speaker: rikka_ember
commands.text: You make every plan sound less fun.
